text:
Cam: Urgent — HelixAnalytics POC hit quota_exceeded during a live walkthrough. They swear portal shows 22k trial credits but API returned 429s. Customer upset.

Renee: Can someone grab the exact error payload + response headers? Need to know if it's rate-limit or billing.

Helix (via SE): Pasted error: > {"error":"quota_exceeded","code":429,"detail":"credits_zero"} They also say portal shows 22000 credits under billing.

Omar: Pulling ledger now for acct helix-io: last_credit_event set credits=0 at 2026-04-05T11:02Z. Portal cache still shows 22000. Looks like webhook replay from billing to portal stalled.

SE-Taylor: Tagging @infra — can you check delivery backlog and any failed webhook retries? Also need a client-friendly explanation that mentions streaming token billing so they know how credits map to streaming.

infra: Checked our event bus: we have a backlog of 83 webhook deliveries to portal-service for the last migration window. The delivery worker retried but hit a transient 502 from portal. Sample edge response from API for helix-io: \n```\nHTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\nx-rate-limit-limit: 200\nx-rate-limit-remaining: 0\nx-rate-limit-reset: 11\nx-account-credits: 0\nx-account-tokens-used: 18400\n```\nPrimary cause is credits on billing DB = 0. Webhook backlog caused portal to show stale positive balance.

billing-bot: Spend alert: helix-io usage $1,850.42 threshold $1,000 triggered at 2026-04-05T11:03:17Z. Credits on file: 0.

Cam: Can we do an emergency top-up for the demo? They need the next 30 minutes.

finance-bot: One-off credit grants > $500 require approval. Approver on-call: @Renee or @Sam-Finance.

Renee: I'm approving for POC continuity. Omar, please proceed and record reason "POC demo emergency - webhook backlog".

Omar: Executing admin: `redwood admin grant-credits --acct helix-io --amount 15000 --note "POC demo emergency"`

billing-bot: Manual credit grant recorded: +15000 credits by Omar at 2026-04-05T11:05:02Z.

infra: Replayed webhook deliveries; portal accepted events and cache invalidated. Portal now reports 15000 credits. Also temporarily muted spend alerts for helix-io for 2h: `POST /alerts/mute?acct=helix-io&duration=2h`.

SE-Taylor: Re-tested with the customer's streaming sample: \n```\ncurl -H "Authorization: Bearer <demo-key>" \ 
 https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"summarize"}'\n```\nResponse 200 streaming. Header `x-account-credits: 14994`, `x-account-tokens-used: 18403`.

Cam: Good. Please send a short customer note explaining: (1) root cause = webhook delivery backlog causing portal/billing mismatch, (2) we granted credits for the demo, (3) we're muting alerts and will reconcile. Keep it short and non-technical.

Renee: I'll draft the note and cc Sales Ops. Also logging internal follow-ups: INF-2026-520 — hardened webhook retries + alert if billing->portal delta > 2000 credits; BILL-2026-214 — reconcile one-off grants and audit trail.

Omar: Action items for infra: increase webhook retry backoff and add circuit-breaker alert when portal returns >10% 5xx over 5m. Also add a test in release pipeline that validates billing->portal sync after migrations.

SE-Taylor: Adding a customer-facing FAQ snippet to the SE playbook about how streaming token consumption maps to credits (including partial-token flush behavior). Will share with Cam to send to HelixAnalytics.

Cam: Thanks team. Keep me posted if anything re-fires. :thumbsup:
